visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A person wearing a silver wig, a red turtleneck sweater, a yellow patterned vest, and a plaid skirt (Character A) stands in a cluttered office/home environment. They introduce themselves with exaggerated facial expressions and hand gestures, holding a pink comb. (2) Another person (Character B) wearing a straw hat and black T-shirt appears, kneeling on the floor and pointing at Character A. (3) Character A steps onto a white digital weight scale; a close-up shows the digital readout settling around 50.85 kg. (4) Character A reacts with shock and continues to argue with Character B, who is now standing and using their hands to mimic binoculars. (5) Character A goes through a series of manic emotional shifts, screaming at the camera while stylized flame and lightning graphics appear around them. (6) Character B is seen sitting on the floor packing snacks into a large brown bag while Character A continues their high-energy monologue in the background. (7) Character A suddenly shifts to a calm, soft-spoken demeanor, fixing their wig and smiling gently at the camera. (8) Character A begins dancing vigorously, spinning around as their wig flies off and on, while informative text overlays about Shopee's services appear. (9) Character B holds up a package of chocolate puffs while speaking directly to the camera in a final promotional shot.
